stem:
The diagram shows a known bar magnet and an unmarked bar X. Indu holds them so the facing ends push apart.

What does this tell her about bar X?

options.text: Bar X is a magnet; only a magnet can repel another magnet.
Bar X is ordinary iron; the push apart is not needed to decide.
Bar X is a magnet because it is drawn the same shape as the known magnet.
Bar X is a magnet only if it attracts the known magnet, not if it pushes it.

teacher.key_rationale: Repulsion between facing ends identifies a magnet. Attraction alone cannot, because iron also attracts.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source gap circuit into known-magnet and unmarked bar with repulsion arrows.
